newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Donna Karan EPS estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Donna Karan EPS estimates cut.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it cut 1996 and 1997 earnings per share estimates for Donna Karan International Inc.
-- shares closed at 18-3/4 on Monday. They were indicated at between 14 and 15 on Tuesday before they opened for trading.
-- Morgan said 1996 profit estimates were cut to $0.82 from $1.00 and 1997 profit estimates were cut to $1.20 from $1.58.
-- Analyst Josie Esquivel was not immediately available for comment.
-- On Monday, the company posted third quarter pro forma earnings per share of $0.61 and predicted breakeven fourth quarter results.
